Name: Cleaner Doghouse Area
Author: Nekotekina
Description:
I was always bothered by the paint cans scattered on the ground (or whatever those are...), the random tires, and the ugly sign on the doghouse's fence (honestly, it looks like more blood than paint). So what this mod does is remove all those things from sight.

[b]Special note:[/b] 90% of users who download my mods forget to endorse them. If you like this mod, consider endorsing it! It shows appreciation for our efforts and greatly helps me by allowing more people to see it.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/WzQQc1T/ENDORSE.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher;
2. Download this mod & extract [CP] Cleaner Doghouse Area folder to Stardew Valley/Mods;
3. Run the game with SMAPI to play.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]
Should be compatible with most mods, unless they change the vanilla map structure.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png[/img]
